messages:
anya: Quick sync — we need to lock the Catalyst Co. customer story schedule and approvals. Interview is Wed 2025-03-19 11:00am PT with their CTO. Goal: short launch post + 2-minute testimonial clip for the product page. Need quote approval + legal sign-off by EOD Mon (3/17).

mason: Got it. I'll handle recording logistics. Can someone confirm which assets Catalyst has rights to share? hero photo? their logo? Also need a 30s and 2m cut preference.

devin: I can do legal review but need the quote text and any redlines from PR before Friday. Heads-up: we should avoid any competitive comparisons in the quote, and mark any non-public metrics as "for internal use" until they approve.

sam: I'll message the customer for permissions today. Quick ask — did we get permission to publish their COGS reduction stat? If not, I'll request it in the same email.

lex: For the launch creative I need 1920x1080 hero image and the logo in vector. If Catalyst can't provide, we can capture a clean speaker frame during the interview for the hero.

anya: Draft quote block to send them (please review):
```
"Redwood's predictable latency and lower token cost let us add real-time summarization to our app without re-architecting infra." — Priya K., CTO, Catalyst Co.
```
Can legal/devex flag anything risky? If OK, Sam can push for approval when he reaches out.

mason: Also proposing two headline options for iteration — pick one or suggest edits:
1) "Catalyst Co. scales live summarization with predictable latency"
2) "How Catalyst cut inference costs and shipped real-time features"
Which feels more press-y vs product-y?

devin: Quote looks fine except replace "token cost" with "inference cost" to avoid jitter around billing specifics. Also add: "Approved for public use by Catalyst Co." line to final approved copy.

sam: Outreach msg I'll send to customer today (short):
> Hey Priya — thanks again. Can you confirm the quote below and confirm we can publish on your site? Also, can you approve the hero image and the metric on COGS? If not approved, we can omit the stat.
I'll paste their reply into this thread.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Catalyst Co. — Case Study Interview" Wed Mar 19 11:00am PT — Recording link: https://meet.redwood.example/catalyst-case-1234

mason: Recording checklist: mic test 10m before, local backup recording, capture 4k speaker frame for hero. Tagging @lex for frame notes.

lex: Perfect. If we have the 4k frame, I can make a 2:1 crop for the hero and a square social image. Send me the raw frame in shared drive.

anya: Timeline recap:
- Today (Fri 3/14): Sam requests quote + rights from Catalyst
- Mon 3/17 EOD: Legal (Devin) + PR (Anya) need final approval on copy
- Wed 3/19: Interview + assets captured
- Fri 3/21: Draft launch post + clip ready for internal review
Please add any blockers now.

mason: I'll add chapters to the recording so editorial can pull the 30s and 2m cuts fast.

sam: Customer confirmed by DM they can approve the quote by Mon morning — will ping once they reply in thread.

devin: Once I have the final quote text I will add the "Approved for public use by Catalyst Co." footer and sign off.

anya: Tiny copy options for the launch social post (two tones):
A) Product-forward: "Catalyst Co. uses Redwood Inference to serve real-time summarization at scale with predictable latency and lower inference cost."
B) Outcome-forward: "With Redwood, Catalyst Co. launched real-time summaries and reduced inference spend — their users are already seeing faster results."
React with :one: or :two: for preferred tone.

mason: Also, can someone draft a 90s webinar promo blurb incase we spin a joint webinar? Quick version: "Join Catalyst Co. and Redwood to learn how real-time summarization moved from prototype to production — live demo + Q&A."

lex: I'll mock two social cards tomorrow based on the selected headline.

anya: Great. Action items: Sam -> confirm quote + rights; Devin -> legal review by Mon EOD; Mason -> recording + clips; Lex -> hero + social; Anya -> finalize launch copy.

sam: On it. I’ll paste customer approval here when it comes in. :thumbsup:

mason: If anyone wants to leave comment on the quote snippet here before I send the customer facing email, please do it in the next hour.

(ongoing, customer reply to be added)
